book.subject: 英语
book.edition: 人教版 PEP（三年级起点）

misconceptions.name: y 结尾没改 i 就加 er
misconceptions.why: 记住了“比较级加 er”，没注意辅音字母加 y 结尾的词要先把 y 改成 i。
misconceptions.move: 列一组：heavy—heavier，funny—funnier，happy—happier，让学生自己说出规律。

misconceptions.name: 该加 -er 的词用了 more
misconceptions.why: 汉语“更重”里有个“更”，就想到 more，说成 more heavy；不知道 heavy 加 er 就已经是“更重”。
misconceptions.move: 拍手数音节：heavy 两拍、以 y 结尾，加 er；beautiful 三拍，才用 more。

misconceptions.name: 有 than 却没用比较级
misconceptions.why: 汉语“比我重”里“重”不变形，就照着用 heavy。
misconceptions.move: 看到 than 就停一下：前面的形容词变了没有？taller、heavier。

misconceptions.name: 不规则动词也加 -ed
misconceptions.why: 多数动词的过去式加 -ed，就把 go、see、eat 这些不规则动词也加上 -ed（goed、seed）。
misconceptions.move: 每学一个不规则动词就记成一对：go—went、see—saw、eat—ate，做成卡片随时抽查。

misconceptions.name: 说过去的事动词没变
misconceptions.why: 汉语说过去的事动词不变，只靠“昨天”“上周”表示时间。
misconceptions.move: 圈出时间词 last weekend、yesterday、ago，看到它们就检查动词变成过去式没有。

misconceptions.name: 用了 did，动词还用过去式
misconceptions.why: 知道是过去的事，用了 did 又把动词也变成过去式，过去时标了两次。
misconceptions.move: 告诉学生：过去只标一次——有了 did，动词就回到原形：Did you watch ...?

misconceptions.name: 把“年龄大”说成 bigger
misconceptions.why: 汉语说“他比我大”，“大”直接对上 big，没想到说岁数要用 old。
misconceptions.move: 黑板上并排写“大两岁 = two years older”“大一号 = bigger”，让学生说出哪一个是在说岁数。

misconceptions.name: 加 er 时没双写末尾字母
misconceptions.why: 只记得“直接加 er”，没注意 big、hot、thin 这类“辅音 + 一个元音 + 辅音”结尾的短词要双写。
misconceptions.move: 把 big、hot、thin、sad 和 tall、long 分两组读，让学生找出前一组的共同点，再双写加 er。

misconceptions.name: 把相差的量补在句末
misconceptions.why: 先把学过的整块 taller than ... 说完，再把“差多少”当补充接在最后。
misconceptions.move: 把“5 centimetres taller”写在一张卡片上当一个整块，让学生把整张卡片放进句子里。

misconceptions.name: 照“高5厘米”把数放在形容词后
misconceptions.why: 汉语“高 5 厘米”数量跟在形容词后面，就照着说 taller 5 centimetres。
misconceptions.move: 上下对照写“高 → 5 厘米”和“5 centimetres → taller”，用箭头标出英语里数量在前。

misconceptions.name: y 结尾没改 i 就加 ed
misconceptions.why: 记住了“过去式加 ed”，没注意辅音字母加 y 结尾的词要先把 y 改成 i。
misconceptions.move: 把 study、cry、play、stay 分两组，追问：y 前面是元音还是辅音？只有辅音 + y 才改 i。

misconceptions.name: 把 fell 和 felt 记混
misconceptions.why: fall 和 feel 的过去式只差一个字母，读音也近，背的时候混在了一起。
misconceptions.move: 写出 fall—fell（摔倒）、feel—felt（感觉）两对，让全班做“摔”的动作说 fell，摸胸口说 felt。

misconceptions.name: 动作词前用了 wasn't
misconceptions.why: 知道过去要用 was，汉语“以前不喜欢”里没有助动词，就把 wasn't 当成过去的“不”。
misconceptions.move: 对比 I wasn't tall. 和 I didn't like cats.，追问：后面有没有 like、go 这样的动作词？有就用 didn't。

misconceptions.name: 说现在的事也用了过去式
misconceptions.why: 前一句用了过去式，后一句顺着写下去，没注意 Now 已经换到了现在。
misconceptions.move: 让学生圈出 before、ago 和 Now，在上方分别标“过去”“现在”，再逐句检查动词。

items.stem: I'm 45 kg. You're 48 kg. You're ____ than me.
right: 有 than，要用比较级；
heavy 以“辅音字母 + y”结尾，把 y 改成 i 再加 er：heavier。

ladder.q: 补全：I'm 1.5 m. You're 1.6 m. You're ____ (tall) than me.
补全：This film is ____ (funny) than that one.
用英语说：我比我姐姐小两岁。
ladder.a: I'm two years younger than my sister.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：I ____ (see) a panda at the zoo last weekend.
right: last weekend 说的是过去，动词用过去式；
see 是不规则动词：see → saw。

ladder.q: 写出过去式：watch ____　clean ____
写出过去式：go ____　read ____　have ____
用英语说：上周末我读了一本书，还洗了衣服。
ladder.a: I read a book and washed my clothes last weekend.

work: Did you watched TV last night?
right: 问句已经用 did 表示过去了，
后面的动词用原形：Did you watch TV last night?

ladder.q: 补全：— Did you clean your room? — Yes, ____ .
变成问句：She washed her clothes.
变成否定句：I saw a film yesterday.
ladder.a: I didn't see a film yesterday.

items.stem: 补全：Last winter, I ____ to Harbin with my family.
right: Last winter 说的是过去，go 的过去式是 went：
I went to Harbin with my family.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：ride ____　eat ____
补全：— Where did you go? — I ____ (go) to Beijing.
用英语说：去年夏天我去了新疆，还骑了马。
ladder.a: Last summer I went to Xinjiang and rode a horse.

work: Last summer we went to Beijing.
right: there 本身就是“到那里”，前面不加 to：
went there，就像 go home 一样。

ladder.q: 补全（不需要就写 ×）：I went ____ home at 5 o'clock.
补全（不需要就写 ×）：We went ____ the park yesterday.
— How did you go there? — 我们坐公共汽车去的。用英语回答。

items.stem: Forty years ago, there ____ no buses in Grandpa's village.
right: 说过去“有”用 there was / there were；
buses 是复数，用 were。

ladder.q: 补全：There ____ a big tree in front of my old house.
补全：Now there ____ many trees on the playground.
用英语说：以前我家附近没有公园，现在有两个。
ladder.a: There was no park near my home. Now there are two.

items.stem: Wu Binbin is 12. John is 11. Wu Binbin is ____ than John.
right: 说岁数的“大”“小”用 older / younger；
big 说的是个头大：Wu Binbin is older than John.
typical: Wu Binbin is bigger than John.

ladder.q: 补全：I'm 12. You're 11. I'm ____ than you.
用英语说：我妹妹比我小。
ladder.a: My sister is younger than me.

ladder.q: 用英语说：Mike 比我大，也比我高。
ladder.a: Mike is older and taller than me.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：My schoolbag is ____ (big) than yours.
right: big 以“辅音 + 一个元音 + 辅音”结尾，
双写末尾的 g 再加 er：big → bigger。

ladder.q: 写出比较级：fat ____　thin ____
写出比较级：sad ____　short ____
补全：Summer is ____ (hot) than spring. The days are ____ (long).

items.stem: Tom 比 Ben 高 5 厘米。Tom is ____.
right: 相差多少放在比较级前面：
Tom is 5 centimetres taller than Ben.
typical: 照汉语“高 5 厘米”的顺序：
Tom is taller 5 centimetres than Ben.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我比你高 3 厘米。
用英语说：Mike 比 John 重 2 千克。
ladder.a: Mike is 2 kilograms heavier than John.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我哥哥比我大三岁。
ladder.a: My brother is three years older than me.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：The baby ____ (cry) all night, so Mum was very tired.
right: 后半句用了 was，说的是过去的事，动词用过去式；
cry 是“辅音字母 + y”结尾，改 y 为 i 再加 ed：cried。

ladder.q: 写出过去式：study ____　worry ____
写出过去式：stay ____　study ____
补全：Yesterday Amy ____ (study) for her test, then she ____ (play) the piano.

items.stem: 补全：Tom ____ off his bike yesterday. Now his foot hurts.
right: yesterday 说的是过去，fall 的过去式是 fell：
Tom fell off his bike yesterday.
typical: 把 fall 和 feel 的过去式记混了：
Tom felt off his bike yesterday.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：fall ____　feel ____
写出过去式：ride ____　hurt ____
用英语说：昨天我从马上摔了下来，但我感觉还好。
ladder.a: I fell off a horse yesterday, but I felt OK.

items.stem: 补全：Last Sunday my friends and I went hiking. We ____ very tired after that.
right: 说过去怎么样用 was / were；
主语 we 是复数，用 were：We were very tired.
typical: We was very tired after that.

ladder.q: 补全：My winter holiday ____ great.
补全：The beaches in Sanya ____ beautiful.
用英语说：昨天我很累，但我的朋友们很开心。
ladder.a: I was tired yesterday, but my friends were happy.

items.stem: 补全：Before, I ____ like cats. Now I love them.
right: like 是动作词，过去的“不”用 didn't + 原形：
Before, I didn't like cats.

ladder.q: 补全（wasn't / didn't）：Before, I ____ tall.
补全（wasn't / didn't）：Before, I ____ wear glasses.
用英语说：以前我不喜欢冬天，因为我不会滑冰。
ladder.a: I didn't like winter because I couldn't ice-skate.

items.stem: 小林这样写变化，你同意吗？
work: The tree was small five years ago.
right: Now 说的是现在，第二句要用现在时：
Now it is very tall.

ladder.q: 补全：It was a seed. Now it ____ a big tree.
补全：There ____ no trees here before. Now there ____ many.
用英语说：以前我的猫很小，现在它很胖。
ladder.a: My cat was small before. Now it is fat.

items.stem: Amy 这样写上周日的事，你同意吗？
work: We didn't go to the park.
right: didn't 已经表示过去，后面的动词用原形：
didn't go，写得对。

ladder.q: 补全：I ____ (not watch) TV yesterday.
变成否定句：She cleaned her room.
用英语说：昨天我感冒了，所以没去上学。
ladder.a: I had a cold, so I didn't go to school yesterday.
